name: fangorn
description: Find anything published on Fangorn, and build apps on it.

plugins.name: fangorn-index
plugins.description: Find what's published on Fangorn and read it: the global index (fangorn.network/mcp) by default, or any index someone runs; the MCP server and the skill that uses it.

plugins.name: fangorn-builder
plugins.description: Build an app on Fangorn: model data as records, publish them, follow and search them, let people publish with their own signature, and get listed.
